title: Greedy (Dice Game): HUD, window and table set-up
layout_order: HUD band (1600 x 900 mock, above the bottom toolbar): LEFT logo + wordmark, YOUR SCORE / THIS TURN, PLAYERS / SCORE scoreboard | CENTRE state line, dice tray with six dice (click lands them), moment banner over the dice, THIS TURN / FIRST TO + DICE TO ROLL, message area | RIGHT ROLL (START / PLAY AGAIN) and BANK (big), then NEW GAME / PRACTICE / JOIN A GAME or LEAVE / PASS THEIR TURN / WINDOW, then HOW TO PLAY, TABLE HERE, BACKGROUND, LESS, CLOSE; LESS mode: one row ROLL, BANK, MORE, CLOSE. Window (wolf_greedy): Full view (logo, View: Full/Table/HUD, table offer, status, scoreboard, tips, THIS TURN, dice on felt, banner, event, Roll/Bank, target + New game/Practice, games list + Join/Refresh, or Leave/Pass, How to play, Put a Greedy table here, message; guide cards replace the middle) or Table view (Full/Table/HUD, status, score, Roll/Bank, Leave/How to play, message). Set-up window (wolf_greedy_setup): logo, title, step, body, Which table? radio, Put the table/board here, Back/Skip/Close, message.
